description: This file defines a class SiloMetadataSystemTarget in the Orleans Runtime for managing silo metadata as a system target, providing access to silo metadata and lifecycle participation.

classes.name: SiloMetadataSystemTarget
classes.description: A sealed internal class that extends SystemTarget and implements ISiloMetadataSystemTarget and ILifecycleParticipant for managing silo metadata in Orleans.

methods.name: GetSiloMetadata
methods.description: Returns the current SiloMetadata wrapped in a Task.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Implements ILifecycleParticipant; currently does not participate in any lifecycle stages.
